output.title: Metric help text fix may touch Prometheus scraping setup
output.content: The change corrects only the help text of `certmanager_certificate_renewal_timestamp_seconds`; the release note does not state any change to the metric's name or value. The environment sets `prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled` and `prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort`, so cert-manager metrics are likely scraped. It also uses `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate`, so this metric may be exported. The operator should check whether any dashboards, alerts or docs rely on the old help text's description of the metric as relative to expiration time. If none do, no action is needed.
